newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Siam Commercial US$100 mln FRCD allotted.
newsitem.headline: Siam Commercial US$100 mln FRCD allotted.

text.p: Siam Commercial Bank's US$100 million floating rate certificate of deposit (FRCD) issue has been allotted, bookrunner BA Asia said Tuesday.
It said the five-year FRCD was priced at par to float at 35 basis points over the three-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 43 basis points.
Arranger BA Asia committed US$21 million. Arrangers with US$15 million each are Nomura International Hong Kong and Sakura Finance Asia.
Lead managers with US$7 million each, are Chase Manhattan Asia, DG Bank, Daiwa Securities Hong Kong, JP Morgan Securities Asia, and Merrill Lynch International.
Co-lead manager Bank of Taiwan Singapore committed US$5 million.
Managers with US$3 million each, are Die Erste Oesterreichische Spar-Casse, National Bank of Abu Dhabi, and Sanwa International Finance.
